information_flow: The first call receives all six common inputs and emits one complete executable policy before forming anchor-relative causal evidence. The final call consumes that exact policy plus the common inputs, forms allowed task-and-contract evidence only after commitment, and reconstitutes the same single lineage as one final policy. The handoff carries executable state rather than analysis alone and introduces no branch or competing candidate.
name: Hypothesis-First Executable Commitment with Post-Commit Evidence
organization: two-call sequential lineage separated by one evidence-timing boundary

calls.objective: Commit exactly one complete contract-compliant executable policy hypothesis from the common inputs before forming any anchor-relative causal audit. Materialize one whole-policy state rather than provisionally accepted edits, and emit no alternatives, scores, traces, or evaluation artifacts.

Consume the immediately preceding executable policy and only then form allowed task-and-contract evidence about the committed whole. Reconstitute that single lineage as a complete contract-compliant policy without terminal causal compression, a review-only verdict, or a competing candidate.
